newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, in consolidation.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Wednesday in view of different expectations on the direction of interest rates, traders said.
The one week rate dipped since rates are seen going lower amid high liquidity in the market, a trader said.
But the three to 12-month rates edged higher in line with expectations that rates will adjust upwards over the longer term after hitting 14-month lows, traders said.
The two-week to two-month rates were steady.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks would be willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
